description: Fuel properties (card M1-05, R 21.4). Physical properties of the fuel, not engine data. Values are typical mid-range figures from the cited references.

lhv_mj_kg.ref: R 21.4; Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals (1988) App. D (gasoline ~43-44 MJ/kg)

stoich_afr.ref: avgas H/C ~2.0-2.1; Heywood App. D (isooctane 15.1, gasoline 14.6)

density_kg_l.ref: ASTM D910 typical 100LL density at 15 C

lhv_mj_kg.ref: DEF STAN 91-091 / ASTM D1655 minimum 42.8 MJ/kg, typical 43.2

stoich_afr.ref: kerosene C12H23 approx.; Heywood App. D

density_kg_l.ref: DEF STAN 91-091 typical density at 15 C (0.775-0.840)
